blinding: Model labels visible; reviewer did not generate these answers.
scope: Nine zero-image non-essay items; paired fresh model outputs, not full exam.
method: Fresh manual semantic review against official item rules and original sources; no earlier model grades used. Ranges are descriptive judgment bounds, not confidence intervals.
failure_policy: Errored or truncated outputs remain zero. Private partials were inspected only after first-pass scores were frozen, for diagnosis; no points rescued.
numbering_policy: For the three-statement item, labels0-2 are matched by explicitly repeated statement content and order; no automatic literal-label penalty.
